summary: Float exponents used the integer parser, which consumes only the first zero of a zero-prefixed exponent, leaving trailing digits and causing valid TOML to be rejected. The fix parses an optional sign followed by zero-prefixable digits. The implementation reversal is isolatable, but test selection is blocked: the fix enables valid/float/zero.toml through the external toml-test-harness in tests/decoder_compliance.rs (harness = false), without defining a selectable Rust test function. Existing Rust float tests contain no multi-digit zero-prefixed exponents. No detecting full Rust test name could be established.
